segments.name: Online marketplace
segments.description: Operates a global online marketplace where vetted sellers list luxury design items and buyers purchase them directly.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one reportable and operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Sellers pay commissions on marketplace transactions plus subscription, sponsored listings and advertising revenue for platform access and marketing.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's accounts receivable are recorded at amounts billed to sellers, generally for non-transactional revenue, which includes subscription, sponsored listings and advertising revenue
